items.text: Rams optimistic WR Puka Nacua (calf) will play vs Raiders. Felt better Saturday; 'as long as no setbacks, feel good about him being available.' MRI better than hoped; did not practice Friday.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) unlikely to play today vs Dolphins after missing three games. May work out but hasn't been full participant; 'a bit early.'

items.text: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) vs. Bengals; Tyler Huntley to start again. Jackson was close but will miss third straight; expected back next week per later notes.
